author: conflee
body: ## Short description Fixes an oversight with Corpse Spawners to ensure they have actual clothing 95% of the time instead of 5% of the time. Added Starlight specific jobs to the corpse pool. Added antag corpse spawners for Syndicate, Nukie, Soviet, Pirate, and Mercenary. ## Why we need to add this Due to an oversight in how Corpse Spawners work, most corpses used to spawn naked. They pulled from the (Job)Gear of a Job, which only had a headset and maybe gloves assigned because 99% of a Job's clothes are given by the Loadout system. I fixed this issue by adding new (Job)CorpseGear StartingGear setups, to force them to spawn with clothing. I also added in corpses for different Starlight unique jobs, like BSO, NT Rep, Magistrate, IAA, Roboticist, Mail Technician, Brig Medic, etc, to make it feel more integrated into our gameplay and world. As a final treat, I added some extra antag corpse spawners for Syndicate, Nukie, Soviet, Pirate, and Mercenary. These are intended for wreck use (Soviet, Pirate, Mercenary, Syndicate) or ADMEME ONLY (Nukie). Useful to have the ability for Event Staff to plop down pre-dressed corpses of Syndicates or Nukies on the fly if needed. ## Media (Video/Screenshots) New distribution, top to bottom; Cargo, Command, Engineering, Medical, Science, Security, Service . Antag corpses, top to bottom; Mercenary, Pirate, Nukie, Syndicate, Soviet ## Checks - [X] I do not require assistance to complete the PR. - [X] Before posting/requesting review of a PR, I have verified that the changes work. - [X] I have added screenshots/videos of the changes, or this PR does not change in-game mechanics. - [X] I affirm that my changes are licensed under the [Starlight Fork License](https://github.com/ss14Starlight/space-station-14/blob/Starlight/LICENSE-Starlight.TXT) and grant permission for use in this repository under its conditions. **Changelog** :cl: Conflee - fix: Fixed corpses spawned by wrecks and corpse markers being naked. - add: Added Starlight specific jobs to the corpse pool. - add: Added antag corpse spawners for Syndicate, Nukie, Pirate, Mercenary, and Soviet, for wreck/event use.

author: laughedelic
body:
This pull request introduces major improvements to the storage API, development workflow documentation, and build/test automation for the any-sync plugin and its example app. The changes streamline the process for adding new API operations, clarify architecture and usage, and enhance both developer and user experience. The most important changes are grouped below:

**Storage API & Documentation Improvements**
* Expanded the `README.md` with a comprehensive section on the new Storage CRUD API (`storagePut`, `storageGet`, `storageDelete`, `storageList`), including usage examples, error handling, and data persistence details. Also added architecture diagrams and clarified data flow from TypeScript to Go backend via Rust and gRPC. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-b335630551682c19a781afebcf4d07bf978fb1f8ac04c6bf87428ed5106870f5L317-R453) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-b335630551682c19a781afebcf4d07bf978fb1f8ac04c6bf87428ed5106870f5R499-R532) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-b335630551682c19a781afebcf4d07bf978fb1f8ac04c6bf87428ed5106870f5L396-R554)
* Updated `AGENTS.md` to provide a step-by-step guide for adding new API operations across all layers (Protobuf, Go, Rust, permissions, TypeScript, UI), replacing the previous fragmented workflow instructions.
* Added a new example app development guide (`examples/tauri-app/AGENTS.md`) with UI/UX principles, anti-patterns, and code organization recommendations for Svelte-based demo apps.

**Build & Test Automation**
* Refactored `.github/workflows/test.yml` to split testing into separate jobs for Go, TypeScript, and Rust, with improved dependency setup and platform matrix.
* Updated build scripts (`build-go-backend.sh`, `build-proto.rs`, `build.rs`) to generate protobuf code for all proto files, not just health.proto, ensuring new APIs are automatically included in builds. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-084fa05b13eec675cdf1fc65a2d131e7590397a8141d19f72ea5496fe9f45cf8L71-R71) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-2459681fac4a6b6d9e863837adfad6f1f8de30bcd74d3afd8378677db6ca5c5bL7-R15) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-d0d98998092552a1d3259338c2c71e118a5b8343dd4703c0c7f552ada7f9cb42R316-R325)

**Example App & UI Enhancements**
* Improved window configuration in `tauri.conf.json` for better sizing and titling in the example app.
* Removed unused demo components (`Greet.svelte`) and refactored global styles in `style.css` for a cleaner, system-native look. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-cb6cda2ed1895017f496d6384531e6538e4b249abd1d32ed35c1ddc90e39f263L1-L22) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1bb976338ae3a3493abc2a2203153d102ce62b413b5b9919a5d80229fed5c75cL2-R8) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-1bb976338ae3a3493abc2a2203153d102ce62b413b5b9919a5d80229fed5c75cL17-L101)
* Added Svelte 5 runes mode to `svelte.config.js` for modern reactivity support.
* Minor improvement to `jsconfig.json` formatting for TypeScript inclusion.

**Development Best Practices**
* Updated `go-backend/AGENTS.md` with best practices for Go dependency management, emphasizing use of native Go tooling for package updates and verification.

These changes collectively make it easier to extend, test, and use the any-sync plugin, while improving documentation and developer onboarding.

author: jorodrigues0
body:
# 📥 Pull Request

## 1. O que está sendo entregue?
Este PR entrega a criação dos repositórios:
AddressRepository
PaymentMethodRepository
Ambos integrados ao Spring Data JPA, fornecendo consultas específicas para as entidades criadas anteriormente.
As funcionalidades entregues são:
AddressRepository
Consulta de endereços por userId, ordenados por padraoEntrega (endereços padrão primeiro).
PaymentMethodRepository
Consulta de um método de pagamento pelo seu id e pelo userId vinculado.

## 2. Por que estamos fazendo essa entrega?
Esses repositórios são essenciais para:
Permitir operações de persistência no banco relacionadas a endereços e meios de pagamento.
Suportar o desenvolvimento das camadas de Service e Controller.
Oferecer consultas especializadas que serão usadas no fluxo de gerenciamento de perfil do usuário.
Facilitar os CRUDs e a manipulação dos dados dessas entidades no backend.
Sem esses repositórios, os módulos de endereço e pagamento não poderiam ser integrados com o banco de dados.

## 3. Quais são as vantagens e as desvantagens dessa solução?
Vantagens
Repositórios implementados com Spring Data JPA, reduzindo código boilerplate.
Query methods claros, intuitivos e sem necessidade de JPQL.
Permite recuperação eficiente de registros do usuário.
Segue padrões e convenções do Spring.

Desvantagens
Consultas ainda básicas; cenários complexos dependerão de custom queries no futuro.
Ausência de paginação nas consultas (dependendo do uso, pode ser necessário).
Falta de validações na camada de serviço (ainda será implementada).

## 4. Os testes unitários foram realizados?
- [ ] Sim  
- [x ] Não

author: eugeniatate-duke
body:
This PR finalizes the app/frontend.py Gradio interface for the Coffee Quality Predictor.

Changes include:
	•	input sanitization:
	•	free-form user input converted into numeric or None.
	•	numeric inputs clamped to 0–10 range to match dataset scoring scale.
	•	fully JSON-compliant payloads are sent to API to prevent serialization errors
	•	front-end validations to block API calls when all values are missing, zeros, or invalid
	•	user-friendly instructions, help text and error messaging 
	•	Improved debug output formatting and color styling for readability.

Citations:
	•	OpenAI. (2025). ChatGPT (Version 5.1) [Large language model]. https://chat.openai.com — used to prototype recursive JSON-sanitization and input coercion logic; final code verified and tested locally.
	

Testing:
- Verified locally with server running on localhost:8000.
- Tested cases:
	•	empty row (rejected)
	•	all zeros (rejected)
	•	valid partial input (predicts successfully)
	•	gibberish + valid numeric (predicts successfully, gibberish converts to null).
